messages:
alex: heads up — us-west2 gnode-23 local NVMe is spiking metadata checksum errors since 08:12 UTC. seeing ~5% GPU allocation failures for P100 pools. tagging #eng-infra and @oncall. logs below.

ops-bot: Alert: NVMe metadata checksum rate spike on host gnode-23 (host=g23-109). 42 events in last 5m. Severity: warning.

sam: paste the dmesg / smart snippet? temp / firmware info? :eyes:

alex: dmesg excerpt:
```
[08:12:21] nvme0: metadata checksum mismatch lba 123456
[08:12:21] nvme0: read failed, retrying
[08:12:22] nvme0: media error - SMART prefailure
```
SMART summary: reallocated_sectors_count rising, temp 67C, power_cycle_count unchanged.

katie: Is this only this node or wider? Any scrub/cleanup jobs overlapped with batch?

alex: Only gnode-23 so far, scratchpool backed. We had batch window at 08:00 and scrub cron at 07:55 — possible overlap causing IO pressure.

sam: Proposed short plan:
1) cordon node (`kubectl cordon gnode-23`)
2) migrate active GPU pods away
3) set scratchpool read-only to stop writes
4) avoid full format — try fsck and vendor diagnostics first

katie: I'll start migrations and raise scrub throttle for us-west2. Also recommend bumping eviction thresholds for a few minutes to avoid cascade.

jordan: Running: `kubectl cordon gnode-23` -> evictions started. Reassigning GPU allocations to us-west2-b as fallback.

alex: Noted: we pushed a small firmware batch to this drive class in us-west2 overnight. @eng-releases did a canary at 02:00 UTC. Could be correlated.

eng-releases: Confirmed — firmware 3.1.4 -> 3.1.5 rolled to 5% canary in us-west2 at 02:10 UTC. No prior alerts. Rolling pause initiated for further hosts in the batch.

sam: If firmware is implicated, rollback plan ready. For now mitigation first. Also opening vendor support ticket with logs.

katie: Mitigations executed: node cordoned, scratchpool set RO, pods moved. Increasing scrubthrottle and delaying next scrub. Monitoring I/O metrics and SMART.

alex: Error rate falling after read-only and migration. SMART reallocated count stabilized. No new allocation fails reported in last 10m, but provisioning latency in region up ~3% due to rebinds. Opening follow-up ticket: INC-2026-042.

katie: Good. Capture this for postmortem if firmware correlates. Add timestamped metrics slice for the scrub overlap. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Alert cleared: metadata error rate returned to baseline after 10m. Incident logged: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-042

alex: Thanks all — continuing vendor conversation and will follow up with root-cause notes.
